title: Push navigation
description: A cobalt record sleeve moves aside to expose a quiet collection index behind it.
useCase: Reveal navigation while preserving the spatial identity of the current content.
interaction: Open the index and choose a collection.
reducedMotion: The foreground plate changes position immediately, retaining all navigation.
limitations: An isolated collection selector, not a router or full-page template. The background navigation is inert while closed.
look: Saturated cobalt-blue full-bleed plate holding an off-white record sleeve with heavy navy sans-serif title and blue looping ring artwork, plus an outlined pill button.
motion: The toggle slides the blue plate 54% right, scales it to 88% and rounds its corners over 380 ms ease-out, exposing the list behind; choosing an item slides it back.
adapt: The push is one transform on `.pn-plate`: `translateX(54%) scale(.88)` under `[data-open=true]` with a `.38s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)` transition; `.pn-drawer` sits beneath, `inert` while closed. Replace `collections`, the sleeve art and titles with your routes.
